<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Metal Scamp](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2644)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

The capricious and destructive metal scamps are self-appointed forces of entropy, taking great pleasure in indiscriminately wrecking everything around them, sometimes even to their own detriment. Metal scamps have a severe appearance, with pointed facial features and angular limbs, and their skin can be the color of any metal, often heavily oxidized as if by years of exposure to the elements.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Elemental](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10)): DC 15

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 13

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 10
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 1">[Metal Scamp](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2644)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Small" />
<trait label="Elemental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=57" />
<trait label="Metal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=505" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 153

**Perception** +3; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12)

**Languages**
[Talican](/Languages.aspx?ID=112)

**Skills**
[Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +7, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +5

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +2

**Dex** +0

**Con** +2

**Int** -2

**Wis** +0

**Cha** +0
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 15 

**Fort** +7 

**Ref** +5 

**Will** +5 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 20
([fast healing](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=15) 2 (while touching metal))

</row>

**Immunities**
bleed, [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=145)

**Resistances**
[electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=56) 3

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 25 feet, fly 25 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
claw +9,
**Damage** 1d6+2 slashing

**Arcane Innate Spells** DC 17, attack +9
- **2nd**
[Magnetic Attraction](/Spells.aspx?ID=944)

**Breathe Shrapnel** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [Metal](/Traits.aspx?ID=505)) The metal scamp breathes a 15-foot cone of jagged metal flakes that deals 2d4 slashing damage and 1d4 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) to each creature within the area (DC 17 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). The metal scamp can't Breathe Shrapnel again for 1d4 rounds.

</column>
